name: [DataRobot] Python 3.11 Keras Drop-In
description: This template environment can be used to create artifact-only keras custom models. This environment contains keras backed by tensorflow and only requires your model artifact as a .h5 file and optionally a custom.py file. It is built on a FIPS base image, but it is not FIPS 140-3 compliant: tensorflow, cryptography and grpcio bundle their own TLS libraries.
